explication: Hex is a cross-platform desktop voice-dictation app: the user holds a shortcut, speaks, and gets locally transcribed text pasted into the active app. The map separates capture, model management and inference, result handling, and desktop/product features. README statements establish the user workflow and local-first behavior; indexed references support several internal links. Some platform and product subsystems are represented by their exact directory paths because their implementation was not sampled, so unverified connections are omitted.
